memberdef.name: applySidecarBinary

briefdescription.para: Entry point of whatdbg: the help page, the macOS re-exec, and the JUCE startup.

detaileddescription.para:
Startup sequence:
help: render the help page to stdout and return.
[macOS] Without the re-exec marker, extract liblldb.dylib and re-exec the process with DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH set to the sidecar folder, so that dyld resolves the liblldb SB API symbols on the second invocation.
[Debug builds] Open whatdbg.log in the config folder and install the crash and terminate handlers.
Extract the sidecar binaries into the sidecar folder.
Call JUCEApplicationBase::main with the program path and the sidecar path. JUCE then calls Whatdbg::initialise.

Sidecar folders, under userApplicationDataDirectory/whatdbg:
Windows: dbgeng DLLs in dbgeng/. Loader loads them from that folder.
macOS: liblldb.dylib in liblldb/.
